item.title: Cost of Living in Kew East Melbourne
item.description:
Budget reality check: what does daily life in Kew East actually cost? No vague estimates - real numbers.

Read our full Kew East suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Kew East Expensive?

Kew East sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Kew East, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.
